exposure: Lifestyle factors (alcohol use, tobacco use, healthy diet)
cohort: 466 healthy pregnant women recruited from Rikshospitalet, Oslo University Hospital, Norway.
finding: In women with advanced maternal age, exercising at least twice weekly was associated with less pelvic girdle pain, lower gestational weight gain, fewer instances of gestational weight gain exceeding 16 kg, and a lower incidence of macrosomia in newborns.
